metadata.source: Derived from snapshot_2026-02-13 (Loki logs + prod PostgreSQL DB). Five real rented 8x A100 executors are opted into GPU splitting with 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7 of their 8 GPUs rented, so the incentive engine must score each of them in BOTH pools (DAH-2467). Two run sysbox and three do not. The five remaining rented 8x A100 nodes are left whole-box as a control. Opting those five into splitting is the only edit; everything else, including the February sysbox rule the source snapshot was captured under, is left as recorded.
